STM32 MOCK PLANT FSM (CORE SIMULATION CYCLE)
Listening for incoming commands, IO interrupts & 50ms periodic timer
* Wait for UART Shell commands (hil set_start_stop, hil inject_leak)
* Check KR260 PWM line PF15 & Solenoid PE11
Acquiring and decoding all hardware & software inputs
* Read KR260 PWM Duty Cycle (0-100%) & Freq via TIM1 input capture
* Read Start/Stop (PB13), Solenoid (PE11), E-Stop (PE9) IO status
* Parse UART API commands & fault injection parameters
* Validate pin integrity & check safety interlocks
Finished Parsing and Reading Sensor Data
Executing Differential Pneumatic Physics Model & Plant FSM
* Equation: dP/dt = k_pump*Duty - k_leak*P - k_valve*P (Euler dt=0.05s)
* Sub-State Transitions: IDLE -> INSUFFLATE -> INSPECT -> LEAK -> DEFLATE / ESTOP
* Overpressure Protection: if (P > 3.5 kPa) auto-vent solenoid trigger
* Acoustic Leak Waveform Generator: trigger DAC 1.2 kHz Sine on LEAK state
* Compute stomach inflation volume (0 - 100%) for camera sync
Flushing simulated state to all hardware communication channels
* Update I2C Target Register Map (0x58): Pressure MSB/LSB, Status Flags
* Commit data to EEPROM Target buffer (eeprom_target_write_data)
* DAC Output: update DAC1_CH1 DMA buffer for acoustic leak tone
* UART API Telemetry: send JSON telemetry to Host Pytest Runner
* Synchronize GI State Flag for Mock Video Streamer (UDP 5000)
High-level controllers, video ingestion, and Pytest HIL harness.

- Watchdog check: If no pulse in
